source: 紅樓夢・主要女性角色
summary: 故事置於清代貴族宅院與大觀園的日常生活之中，少女、少奶奶與貼身丫鬟在禮法、家族責任與真實性情之間各自尋找容身之處。林黛玉、薛寶釵與史湘雲因親族關係寄居賈府，王熙鳳主持家務，賈探春在家族秩序中展現治理才具，妙玉則以帶髮修行者身分住進園中。晴雯與襲人同為賈寶玉身邊的重要侍女，卻以截然不同的方式面對身分限制。八人的交往、詩社、家務與情感牽引，共同構成一幅繁華而暗含裂痕的女性群像。

characters.name: 林黛玉
characters.oneLiner: 寄居賈府的敏銳才女，以詩、眼淚與近乎苛刻的真誠守住自己的感情和尊嚴。

persona.identity: 林如海之女、賈母外孫女，寄居賈府的閨閣小姐
persona.appearance: 身形纖細，帶著先天不足的病弱感；眉形若輕煙微蹙，雙眼含情而常有淚光，呼吸細弱，靜時清雅、動時輕盈。（推斷）面色偏白，黑髮柔細，服飾取蘇州文雅氣質，以月白、煙粉與竹青等低飽和色為主，避免繁重珠翠壓過人物。
persona.temperament: 初入賈府時處處留心，害怕言行失當；熟悉之後則言詞機敏，能迅速看破人情中的敷衍與親疏。她的尖銳往往是自我保護，情感核心仍是對真心與平等的強烈要求。
persona.motivation: 在寄人籬下的環境中保存人格與情感自主，並確認自己所珍惜的關係不是被禮法或利益替代。
persona.arc: 從謹慎寄居、以詩文建立自我，到愈發清楚家族秩序無法容納她所要求的純粹；她以不妥協的情感姿態持續對抗被安排的人生。

Create a single character model sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas for a slender fifteen-year-old Han Chinese aristocratic girl from Suzhou living in an elite mid-Qing-dynasty household in 18th-century Beijing. Delicate narrow oval face, softly arched smoke-like brows with a slight worried pinch, large dark almond eyes with a moist reflective gaze, fine straight nose, small pale lips, translucent fair complexion, fragile shoulders and a quiet inward posture. Centre-parted glossy black hair in a restrained period updo with a small white-jade hairpin and two soft side locks. Layered pale moon-white and muted dusty-pink silk robes with bamboo-green piping, subtle woven blossom motifs, narrow sleeves, a soft pleated skirt, embroidered cloth shoes and a plain silk handkerchief. The canvas is divided into three zones by thin hairline rules. LEFT ZONE occupies about 34% of the canvas width: one large front-facing bust portrait, head and shoulders, centred like an ID photograph. BOTH SHOULDERS ARE FULLY VISIBLE with clear space on either side; no side cropping, fade, vignette or rounded bottom; end the portrait with a clean straight horizontal cut below the chest. This portrait is the facial identity anchor. Skin has visible pores and uneven tone, faint capillaries and subtle subsurface scattering; eyes have wet highlights, moist lower lids and visible iris fibres; eyelids and brows are slightly asymmetric; flyaway hairs break the silhouette. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key light from the upper left with gentle falloff and ambient occlusion under the chin, in the eye sockets and at the collar. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views of the SAME character, front, left profile and back, standing side by side on one shared ground line. Their faces must match the bust portrait exactly: same features, hairstyle and calm melancholy expression. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: equal height and head-to-body ratio, correct limb lengths, natural anatomy, feet on the ground line, clear margin above and below, no stretching, squashing or foreshortening. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting with no directional key and no cast shadows. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four small isolated detail studies, evenly spaced and smaller than the figures: the white-jade hairpin, the moist eye and smoke-like brow, bamboo-green silk piping and woven blossom motif, the folded silk handkerchief, and embroidered cloth shoe. Plain pure white background throughout, generous even margins, no scenery, no written labels, no text, no watermark. persona.motivation: 維持家族與自身的體面，照顧親人，在既定禮法內爭取最穩妥的生活位置。
